objective: Create and govern a cross-cutting Capital Intelligence and Rotation Architecture addendum that integrates smart-capital-flow evidence, cross-asset rotation, opportunity/risk controls, continuous evaluation and portfolio-allocation intelligence without mutating the frozen Master Roadmap, reopening completed P08-P11 work, or authorizing P12/Live/Auto execution.
scope: Define Smart Capital Flow Intelligence (SCFI) as a multi-source evidence layer over canonical P09 order-flow/liquidity, P10 macro/on-chain/commodity and P11 news/sentiment outputs
Define Cross-Asset Capital Rotation & Reallocation Engine (CARE) for KEEP, REDUCE, ROTATE, HEDGE and EXIT portfolio-action candidates
Define Opportunity Value and Relative Strength ranking across eligible Crypto, Forex, Gold and cash-like exposures
Define No-Trade Guardian, Market Regime gating, Capital Preservation Mode and portfolio Risk Budget requirements
Define Decision Autopsy and probability-calibration feedback loops without automatic Live promotion
Strengthen the existing P14 Red-Team/Devil's-Advocate challenge boundary
Define cost-aware rotation with fees, spread, slippage, funding/carry, liquidity, latency, uncertainty and hysteresis
Define Opportunity League ranking and Persian explainability requirements for P23

Define the permanent parallel Demo/Shadow laboratory with approximately 20 governed accounts/portfolios and a minimum two-month continuous evaluation window, with sample-size/regime sufficiency also required
Define the impact/remediation matrix for P05-P24, including explicit NO_CHANGE, EXTEND_LATER, NEW_COMPONENT and NO_DELETE decisions
Preserve whale/on-chain large-flow activity as supporting evidence only, never a standalone trading signal
Preserve Research → Backtest → Demo → Shadow → Manual/Semi-Auto → Micro-Capital/Canary → Controlled Auto
out_of_scope: Starting P12 implementation or granting P12 phase authorization
Reopening or invalidating canonical P08, P09, P10 or P11 closures
Breaking existing completed contracts; any future extension must be backward-compatible or separately versioned
Selecting production brokers, exchanges, wallet-label vendors, news vendors or on-chain providers
Using whale activity, one large transfer, one news item or one indicator as a standalone trade trigger
Live Trading, Auto Trading, funding accounts, placing orders or provisioning trading credentials
Hard-coding profitability, win-rate or rotation thresholds before governed empirical calibration
dependencies: Owner authorization in project conversation on 2026-10-11
No active governed task or lock at task start
tests: P08-P11 canonical completion and gate evidence remain valid
SCFI explicitly forbids whale activity as a standalone trade signal
CARE output is a portfolio-action candidate and cannot bypass P15 Risk or P16 Pre-Trade Firewall
No completed API/contract is declared for destructive replacement; completed work is NO_CHANGE or future backward-compatible extension
Two-month / 20-account evaluation is not treated as sufficient by time/count alone; sample size, regime diversity, calibration and execution realism are also required
No arbitrary profitability, correlation or rotation threshold is introduced
Live Trading and Auto Trading remain DISABLED
security_tests: A5 Risk and P16 Pre-Trade Firewall retain veto
LLM/agent output cannot directly place or authorize a live order
Unverified wallet labels and transfer attribution fail closed or remain low-confidence context
evidence: Git SHA and PR Governance result
rollback: Revert FIN-P00-WZ-001 task contract, the Capital Intelligence and Rotation Architecture addendum, and its shared-state registration. The frozen Master Roadmap, completed P08-P11 phases, P12 authorization boundary and all trading states remain unchanged.
definition_of_ready: Canonical main is reconciled through P11 closure
No open PR conflicts with write paths
definition_of_done: Impact/remediation decisions are explicit for P05-P24
SCFI and CARE boundaries are explicit
All twelve additional intelligence/risk/evaluation proposals are mapped into future phases
No destructive change to completed phases is required
Task Catalog, Current State, Execution Roadmap and Linear are reconciled
